mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_quality_report ( task_id, user_id, conversation_id, snapshot_date, scoring_version, sku_count, high_risk_count, summary, header_json ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{snapshotDate}, #{scoringVersion}, #{skuCount}, #{highRiskCount}, #{summary}, #{headerJson} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), conversation_id = VALUES(conversation_id), snapshot_date = VALUES(snapshot_date), scoring_version = VALUES(scoring_version), sku_count = VALUES(sku_count), high_risk_count = VALUES(high_risk_count), summary = VALUES(summary), header_json = VALUES(header_json)

INSERT INTO ai_quality_issue ( task_id, sku_id, quality_score, ops_score, risk_level, explosion_score, explosion_candidate, issues_json, skipped_rules, feature_excerpt ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{skuId}, #{qScore}, #{opsScore}, #{risk}, #{expScore}, #{candidate}, #{issuesJson}, #{skipped}, #{excerpt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quality_score = VALUES(quality_score), ops_score = VALUES(ops_score), risk_level = VALUES(risk_level), explosion_score = VALUES(explosion_score), explosion_candidate = VALUES(explosion_candidate), issues_json = VALUES(issues_json), skipped_rules = VALUES(skipped_rules), feature_excerpt = VALUES(feature_excerpt)
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, user_id, conversation_id, snapshot_date, scoring_version, sku_count, high_risk_count, summary, header_json, created_at FROM ai_quality_report WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND (user_id = #{userId} OR user_id IS NULL) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT sku_id, quality_score, ops_score, risk_level, explosion_score, explosion_candidate, issues_json, skipped_rules, feature_excerpt FROM ai_quality_issue WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
